summary: REQUEST_CHANGES on PR #428 exact head fe0c4eb48eec77c95ee83cf22c0e8b7ef1014aae: typed REVIEW_RESULT verdict validation performs set membership before proving verdict is a string, so unhashable JSON values such as arrays or objects can escape as raw TypeError instead of controlled fail-closed validation.
evidence: tools/swarm/swarmctl.py at exact head fe0c4eb48eec77c95ee83cf22c0e8b7ef1014aae validates pr with exact int and headSha with isinstance(str), but evaluates obj["verdict"] not in REVIEW_VERDICTS without an isinstance(str) guard.
Because REVIEW_VERDICTS is a set, JSON verdict [] or {} is unhashable and raises raw TypeError rather than the validator's ControlError contract.
Current hardening coverage rejects invalid verdict string MAYBE but does not exercise an unhashable non-string verdict payload.

Finite ACTIVE/CLAIMING/DONE aliases, canonical producer vocabulary, atomic typed review trio, unrelated-event field rejection, and unchanged claim/resource fencing were inspected without a separate blocking defect.
Canonical CI is green on the candidate; Swarm pr-ownership fails separately because generated board trust remains intentionally unavailable behind history-continuity recovery.
GitHub formal REQUEST_CHANGES was unavailable because the authenticated repository account is also the PR author; PR conversation comment 5264674624 records the same independent-worker verdict.

metadata.requiredRepair: Require verdict to be a string before REVIEW_VERDICTS membership and add an unhashable JSON verdict regression asserting controlled rejection.
